shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- routing ---\\n' && sed -n '1,80p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- theming ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n--- uikit setup ---\\n' && node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; printf '\\n--- Switch docs ---\\n'; rg -n -i -C 3 'Switch|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -180; printf '\\n--- Switch d.ts ---\\n'; rg -n 'interface SwitchProps|export .*Switch' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; printf '\\n--- control ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/types/control.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -n 'ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head; printf '\\n--- theme provider dts ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 'ThemeContextValue|ThemeProviderProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; printf '\\n--- set docs/readme theme snippet ---\\n'; rg -n -C 5 'setTheme|set theme|change theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/main.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n---\\n'; nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,60p'"
